scenarios.behavioral_expectation: First launch requests Microphone and Accessibility sequentially and remains responsive while System Settings is open.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The nonmodal wizard requests the same permissions, polls asynchronously, and enables the hotkey only after both grants are factual.
scenarios.intentional_deviation: Swift uses Carbon for the global hotkey and therefore does not request Input Monitoring.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Relaunch with one missing grant resumes setup without marking it complete.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Relaunch re-queries both TCC services and resumes at the missing grant without a modal run-loop or hang.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Previously granted permissions bypass setup and recording is immediately available.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The signed app reuses existing grants for the same identity and does not reopen System Settings.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Hotkey starts recording, the second press stops it, and one editable popup appears.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The explicit state machine produces one recording, one finalization, and one popup outcome.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Silence does not create hallucinated text or a duplicate completion.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Short/silent guards return no-speech and complete the session exactly once.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Every queued speech chunk is drained on stop and text order is preserved.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Typed chunks remain generation-scoped, drain in order, and none are dropped at finalization.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Rapid presses never overlap recorders or inject stale text.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Generation checks and state gating serialize transitions and discard stale callbacks.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Soft timeout stays processing; hard timeout invalidates the stuck request and returns to a usable state.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Soft/hard deadlines preserve truthful UI state, abort the matching decode generation, and recover exactly once.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Hotkey while the editor is open records more speech and appends it without losing the target app.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Append mode retains the original target PID and adds one space-delimited transcription to the open editor.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Enter confirms, Escape cancels, and an empty confirmation never injects stale content.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Exactly one decision wins and empty/cancel paths clean up without text delivery.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Command-D adds the selection or caret word after validation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The same selection/caret rule reaches the transactional dictionary coordinator once.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Injection waits for stable focus restoration to the captured target process.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Main-actor PID checks confirm a stable target before the background delivery operation.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: All pasteboard flavors are restored unless the user copies something new during injection.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The pasteboard snapshot is conditionally restored only while the temporary write still owns changeCount.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Local Whisper meets the accepted multilingual corpus quality and latency baseline.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned whisper.cpp passes predeclared WER, command, terminology, latency, and RSS thresholds on the same 42-phrase corpus.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Gemini/OpenAI requests preserve language and prompt hints and recover from bounded transient failures.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Injected HTTP clients enforce provider payload, timeout, retry, cancellation, and privacy contracts.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Configured cloud STT returns usable text and actionable authentication/network errors.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Real Gemini and OpenAI credentials activate only their selected backend and failures never fall back silently.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Supported files decode in order, show progress, can cancel, and never modify the source.
scenarios.expected_behavior: AVFoundation decoding produces bounded 16 kHz chunks, ordered output, cancellation, and an editable result.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Local Qwen cleans Russian, English, and mixed text conservatively within the realtime bound.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned Qwen passes the golden prompt/output suite and always falls back to original text on non-success.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Gemini receives dictionary and correction hints and does not overlap timed-out requests.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Fixture HTTP tests prove prompt parity, request ownership, timeout, cancellation, and original-text fallback.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: A valid Gemini key enables editing and an invalid key produces an actionable error.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Keychain-backed activation succeeds/fails factually without logging credentials.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Model, key, and backend changes apply safely while idle and preserve the working runtime on failure.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Desired and active runtimes remain distinct; latest-generation activation wins and rollback preserves the prior service.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Recent phrases appear newest-first, paginate five at a time, and copy phrase text only.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The injected history store supports the same structure, copy privacy, invalidation, and 100k-row bounds.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Menu ordering, labels, checkmarks, status icons, and history are coherent on every open.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Immutable snapshots render the parity inventory with factual permission/runtime/download/autostart state.
scenarios.intentional_deviation: The Input Monitoring row is intentionally absent because the Swift hotkey uses Carbon.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Confirmed edits update dataset, corrections, history, usage, suggestions, and prompt state coherently.
scenarios.expected_behavior: One transactional coordinator applies the same ordered, idempotent learning flow and atomic persistence.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Terms, Suggestions, Replacements, and Statistics reopen with current data and preserve actions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reusable panels refresh coordinator snapshots and expose the same add/edit/delete/accept/reject/revert flows.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: All supported config schemas and persistence files remain readable and unknown keys survive.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Sanitized schema fixtures round-trip Swift acceptance round-trip and Swift→established behavior→Swift without loss; corrupt originals remain untouched.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Gemini/OpenAI credentials use stable Keychain service/account names and values are never exposed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Swift uses the compatible service/accounts, validates provider-specific formats, and tests only metadata through an injected store.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Wake prewarms only while idle and the next recording remains usable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Workspace wake events schedule an idle-only prewarm without stealing the first real decode.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Audio-device loss stops cleanly and a later recording can recover.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The recorder reports one typed failure, releases the stream, and reopens a valid device on the next session.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Cloud loss fails within a bound and later requests recover without stale overlap.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Typed cloud errors preserve the session/runtime and recovery succeeds after connectivity returns.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Only complete usable models become selectable and working models survive failed downloads.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Exact size/format/SHA validation and atomic activation protect the working installation.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Cancelled or interrupted downloads can continue safely without corrupt activation.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Durable partial bytes resume only with matching source identity, validator, and byte range; process termination loses no acknowledged bytes.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Launch at Login reflects the actual registered state and explains required user approval.
scenarios.expected_behavior: SMAppService status is re-queried after every action and System Settings approval is surfaced factually.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Only a newer compatible release is offered.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Pinned metadata and the candidate must pass version, channel, architecture, macOS, checksum, identity, signature, runtime, entitlement, and Gatekeeper policy.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: A failed update never destroys the only working application.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The helper keeps a same-volume backup and restores it after every simulated install/launch/acknowledgement failure.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: An installed update preserves user data and grants, and a controlled failure rolls back.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The same-identity notarized candidate preserves TCC, models, Keychain, autostart, and data; helper rollback restores the prior signed app.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: The published application opens through Gatekeeper and carries the stable product identity.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The final app and DMG have the expected Team ID, hardened runtime, nested signatures, notarization tickets, and manifest digest.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Every supported locale renders complete labels and valid menu icons.
scenarios.expected_behavior: EN/RU/UK/DE/ES/FR keys and placeholders match exactly and required template icons resolve.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Primary workflows are understandable and complete in the selected language.
scenarios.expected_behavior: RU, EN, and DE signed-app workflows contain no truncation, fallback keys, or untranslated controls.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Panels remain readable and correctly placed across appearance and display configurations.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Sanitized panels pass light/dark snapshots and physical Retina/two-display placement review.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Core flows are keyboard operable and expose understandable accessibility labels.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Keyboard-only and VoiceOver users can navigate setup, menu panels, editor, dictionary, file, and update flows.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Only one instance owns resources and quit tears down workers, streams, timers, and monitors.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The lock rejects a second owner and ordered shutdown releases each runtime resource once.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Runtime diagnostics never contain transcript, prompt, or clipboard content.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Structured telemetry rejects content-bearing field names and acceptance artifacts contain identifiers/metrics only.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Long-running use remains responsive without stale UI, lost rows, orphaned audio, or runaway memory.
scenarios.expected_behavior: A signed eight-hour mixed lifecycle run has no crash/hang/privacy leak and remains within predeclared resource bounds.

scenarios.behavioral_expectation: Swift configuration migration preserves supported user data across a Swift round-trip.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Swift migrates supported schema versions and preserves unknown keys when configuration is read, migrated, and written again.
